locked_conventions.schedule: lambda=p/2 with odd integer p>=5 and n_star=p^2+6+ceil((2/pi^2)*log(200*lambda^2+25)*log(20))
locked_conventions.physical_blocks: label 8 is one block; labels 12,16,... below n_star form the rest block after orthogonal deflation against the physical label-4 anchor
locked_conventions.source_metric: D_bd=D_8 direct_sum D_R is deliberately block diagonal and is not the full exterior source Gram
locked_conventions.quotient_domain: all pseudoinverses and inverse actions are restricted to K_L=range([W_8 W_R])
locked_conventions.sampling_cross_terms: the squared sum in the low action and the additive low/high action bound are retained
locked_conventions.fixed_index_limits: rho8 and d12/d8 are qualitative non-effective limits, never finite pilot inequalities
locked_conventions.complements: the physical complement K_L^perp is not identified with the Fourier-high subspace

locked_formulas.quotient: Delta_L=R_L^dagger on K_L and Delta_L^(-1)=R_L on K_L
locked_formulas.fixed_limits: rho_8 tends to -sqrt(70)/16 and d_12/d_8 is asymptotic to (8192*pi^4/1485)*lambda^8
locked_formulas.metric_counterexample: W=[1,1], D_bd=2*I, D_full=[[2,-1],[-1,2]] gives Gamma_bd=1 and Gamma_full=4
locked_formulas.complement_counterexample: Q=diag(1,-1,1), K_L=span(e1), F_high=span(e3) gives low floor 1, Fourier-high floor 1, and physical-complement floor -1
